title: The puzzle
text: Face D starts on the ground. Roll the tube to put face J on top. How few other faces must land flat?

title: Your guess
text: I count three steps along the strip to face J. Three looks tempting. Which number would you choose?

title: Fold the tube
text: Let's fold the net into a regular ten-sided tube. Every turn is equal, and face I meets face B. Face D rests flat on the ground. Face F sits flat on top.

title: The upside-down trap
text: Watch three rolls across face E, face H, and face J. Stop! Face J landed on the ground. Face G is on top. We wanted face J up there. That is the upside-down trap.

title: Find the opposite
text: To put face J on top, its opposite face must land flat on the ground. On a regular ten-sided tube, opposite is halfway round: five steps. Count from face J: one, two, three, four, five. That's face G. Face G belongs on the ground.

title: Roll the short way
text: Reset to face D, count zero. The other way takes eight rolls. Let's roll the short way towards face G. First, face A lands flat. Second, face G lands flat. Look straight up: face J is flat on top!

title: Check Question 14
text: Let's check Question 14. Option A says one — that counts only face A between them and misses face G landing. Option C says three — that counts face D by mistake, or rolls face J onto the ground. Option D counts all four panels from face D to face J. Face A and face G both land. That's two faces. Choose option B.

title: Your turn
text: Your turn. This tube has a regular eight-sided end. Face K starts on the ground. Roll the tube to put face R on top. How few other faces must land flat?

title: Octagon proof
text: Rolling one step onto face R puts face R on the floor. Halfway round eight sides is four steps, so face L is opposite face R. The long way takes five rolls. Take the short way from face K. Face W lands first. Then face P. Then face L. Two would miss that last landing. Four would count the start. Three faces land. Choose option C.

title: Pocket rule
text: Regular, even-sided tube? Roll the shortest way to the face opposite your chosen top. Count each landing.
